route_policy: T1.1 camera-only development route frozen from navmesh geometry: move through waypoint 0 to waypoint 1, turn toward waypoint 2, then continue. No predictor output, semantic GT, room labels, or annotations. Each consecutive waypoint pair is resolved and validated independently; no teleport or endpoint-only path query.
route_collision_scope: Habitat navmesh footprint and no-slide movement-filter assurance; physics disabled; navmesh include_static_objects is recorded at runtime and independent static-object collision coverage is not claimed
